facts.title: biome: exclude generated and non-JS config files
facts.body: Recorded review of a bounded repository change. Original identifying metadata removed.
facts.author: contributor
facts.diff: Reconstructed evidence: Add file exclusions to the shared linter configuration.

works-and-proven.name: works-and-proven
checked: Mapped the one changed behavior, the new `files.includes` in `biome.json` (lines 4–16), against every eval that reads `biome.json`: `.claude/eval/web-lint-configs.test.sh`, `new-repo.test.sh` and `provision-public-repo.test.sh:4540-4545`. The goal was to find the assertion that would fail if the `dist`/`build`/`coverage` skip or the JSON/`.vue`/`.svelte`/`.astro` skip stopped working. None of them asserts it. `web-lint-configs.test.sh` only runs `biome lint`/`check`/`format` on files named explicitly (`bad.ts`, `good.ts`, `ugly.ts`). The provisioner eval only diffs the written bytes against project's copy, and those bytes change together with the file. This probe would have caught a changed behavior with no automated pin; it found one (see finding).
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

findings.what: No automated test protects the new checker exclusions.

principal-engineer.name: principal-engineer
checked: Fetched `biome.json` at head sha c966c5d and compared its new `files.includes` (lines 4–16) with the hook's `exclude: '\.(jsonc?|vue|svelte|astro)$'` in `.pre-commit-config.yaml:180` and `.github/scripts/pre-commit-suite-merge.py:171`. This would have caught a context bug where the config and the hook disagree about which extensions are in scope. They agree: json, jsonc, vue, svelte and astro are excluded in both places. The list also starts with `"**"`, so the negations have something to subtract from, and all other files stay in scope.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

findings.what: The broad exclusions can hide source code in commonly named folders.

maintainable-no-slop.name: maintainable-no-slop
checked: Fetched the diff at c966c5d. The whole PR is one hunk: `biome.json:4-16` adds a `files.includes` block. I read it for comments, code paths or dependencies. That would have caught comment drift, an error-swallowing path or a new package name. There are none: the file is pure JSON config with no comments, no logic and no dependency.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

house-style.name: house-style
checked: Held the new `files.includes` block in `biome.json` (lines 4–16 at c966c5d) against the biome-check hook's `exclude: '\.(jsonc?|vue|svelte|astro)$'` (`.pre-commit-config.yaml:180`). I also compared it with the suite generator's copy of that exclude (`.github/scripts/pre-commit-suite-merge.py:171`) and the eval's copy (`.claude/eval/provision-public-repo.test.sh:4173`). This would have caught a file-type exclusion list that differs from the organization's one existing statement of what Biome must skip (for example, `.jsonc` or one of the three framework extensions missing, or an extra type). The five types match exactly.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

voice.summary: The exclusions fix unwanted checks but have no regression test. Add coverage before merging.
